changes.title: Amazon CloudWatch announces basic OpenTelemetry enrichment at no additional cost
changes.detail: Amazon CloudWatch now offers basic OpenTelemetry enrichment for AWS service metrics at no additional cost. Basic enrichment turns the metrics that AWS services publish to CloudWatch into OpenTelemetry data points you can query with PromQL. It covers metrics that identify a resource, such as Amazon EC2 CPUUtilization with an InstanceId dimension. Enriched metrics get resource attributes for the Amazon Resource Name, cloud provider, Region, and account ID, plus an instrumentation scope naming the source service.
